nom: The INKEY List Caffeine De-puffing + Dark Circle Eye Cream

avis.texte: Theinkeylist Eye Cream is a great eye cream super hydrating and smooth makes my eyes feel super smooth and works so great under concealer and my makeup doesn't cause any creasing. gifted by theinkeylist complimentary from theinkeylist

I've officially added the Bio-Active Ceramide Eye Cream by The INKEY List into my skincare routine 🤍 I've been loving how lightweight and hydrating it feels around my eyes without feeling heavy or greasy. It leaves my under-eye area feeling smooth, moisturized, and refreshed exactly what I want, especially on those tired-mom days. 😂✨ Thank you to The INKEY List for gifting this to me! 🤍 My thoughts are always my own, and I'm excited to keep using it and see how my skin continues to respond. gifted by theinkeylist

I really like this eye cream! It feels lightweight and hydrating without being greasy. It leaves the skin around my eyes looking smoother and refreshed. Definitely a nice addition to my routine! #giftedbytheinkeylist

complimentary from theinkeylist I got there new lifting mask. Love this for my under eyes !After a few hours a can really see my under eyes improving. I will be purchasing this next time. Love this product.

✨ I've been enjoying this eye cream! The texture feels smooth and lightweight, absorbs nicely, and leaves my under-eye area feeling hydrated and refreshed. It layers well under makeup without feeling heavy or greasy. A lovely addition to my skincare routine! gifted by theinkeylist

Thank you gifted by the inkeylist i love it small I can take it anywhere when I need to use it. Thank you again the inkey list for sending me this.I can't wait to let my siblings know about this eye cream.
I bought this based on a recommendation and am very disappointed. I see and feel no difference or change. Not even a cooling feeling.

avis.titre: I have bought this product again!
avis.texte: This product does what it promises. I have bought more expensive products but this is my favorite.

I used this product for about 10 days and it went on smooth, no irritation to the skin. I had not noticed much as far as improvements to my under eye area but did experience excessive eye/eyelid twitching due to the caffeine. I stopped the eye cream 3 days ago and still am experiencing eye twitches! I would avoid this product.
My 60 year old mom and I used it, it worked very well. We loved it! We will purchase it again! Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Amazing hydrating and depuffing eye cream
avis.texte: I've used this eye cream for several months now and it's a great refreshing and hydrating product. It reduces dark circles compared to no eye cream use, but results aren't super noticable compared to other eye creams. It's very affordable and feels nice and hydrating in the morning and at night.
Might as well just put water on my face and call it a day. No difference after 2 months, still look exhausted.

I can tell the difference between using and not using this product. I've recently started reusing this and I think it definitely works for dark circles. I haven't noticed much for de-puffing, but I think it's a good product for the price and I like the ingredients.
But there's something I'm allergic to contained within as the skin under my eyes peeled.

This product was life changing. It reduced my fine lines and brightened my dark circles. I've repurchased it twice and bought it as a gift for friends. For reference im 32, postpartum aka sleep deprived and my under eyes feel revived!

avis.titre: Not sure of how efficient this has been for me.
avis.texte: Still experimenting with this product and cannot say there has been as big of an improvement as I had hoped for.
I tried this product for 1.5 months with no reduction in under eye puffiness.
I got this because I wake up with really puffy eyes and this cream does nothing. No bad effects, no good effects, nothing.
I've only been using this a short time and it seems ok. Not much difference yet. I like the texture and it sits well under makeup

avis.titre: The eye cream didn't address dark eye circles.
avis.texte: I used the eye cream for a solid three weeks. It did depuff. I had purchased it for the dark circles, but I didn't notice any changes. I used it both am and pm. I will be returning it tomorrow.

it's an alright eye cream. I understand that it's fairly affordable, so I didn't expect much from it. if you already have pretty healthy under eyes, it's okay, but if you're looking to get rid of dark circles and bags go for something with better ingredients.

I don't hate this cream because it feels nice, but i have seen no difference in the puffiness that happens with my eyes when i use it. Ive given it a few tries in different situations (in the morning at my puffiest, at night, etc) and it just does nothing. Id recommend looking elsewhere for a similar product. I do however recommend some of Inkey List's other products like their hydrating most or gel moisturizer!

I actually got this because I thought it'd be better to have a proper caffeine under eye cream as opposed to the caffeine serum I've been using from The Ordinary, but after about a week of comparing them, this one just doesn't work as well for brightening the purpley hollow areas around my eyes. It's not entirely ineffective, but with this there is still darkness around my eyes, while the serum completely brightens the area. It's also more irritating on my skin than the serum. It's just worse and more expensive.
This cream would burn my eyes as soon as I applied it. Wouldnt recomemned. The skin around my eyes are now recovering since it burned and dried my eye skin out
Bought because of all the positive reviews but this product has done nothing and made no difference, would not recommend

avis.titre: Works great but not under makeup…
avis.texte: I've been using this for a couple months now and while I love using it in my AM skincare routine for the puffiness around my eyes, I've deduced that this profuct is causing my concealer/powder under my etes to crease/separate/look weird. I've tried giving it plenty of time to dry down but it always seems to disrupt the makeup I put on later. Would recommend for people who don't wear a ton of makeup! It's great for the price :)
Did not care for the product. It was too watery. I did not return it. I have not used it enough to see if it worked. Product was recommended by one of the sales persons.

Saw someone recommend this in tiktok so I decided to try it out. After using it for a week or so, i started noticing the skin around my eyes becoming red snd patchy. They would burn when i touched them. The only new product i have used is this one. I unfortunately do not recommend
Good if have puffy eyes in the morning! Doesnt hurt if you accidentally get it in your eye.

avis.titre: Beware if you have sensitive eyes!
avis.texte: Used this for a few weeks and noticed I started getting an allergic response. So I stopped using but it's been almost 3 months of up and down allergy related issues with my eyes since using this product. So if you have sensitive eyes…be careful or just don't use it
Feels great when I first put this on, but my under eyes end up looking so dry later.

I received this product in gratis as I am an Ulta Beauty beauty advisor and I am so glad I did! I had been looking for something to take away some of the discoloration under my eyes and this did the trick for me (along with better sleep). It may not work for others since their darkness may be because of pigment, so you should use vitamin c or niacinamide instead! (Look up the pinch eye test for undereye circles!) For my concern, it works perfectly and the price is fantastic. I would definitely recommend if you have blood vessel caused under eye darkness.
Made my under eye so dry and did see any improvement after almost two months of using
For me this eye cream relieved my under eye puffiness in just a week and improved my under eye overall look . I didn't get any redness or allergic reaction to it or to other the inkey list products .

avis.titre: Waiting to see how it works
avis.texte: The eye cream has a light, smooth texture and it is non-greasy. I have not yet observed a difference in my undereyes after 3-4 days of use. Will continue to use and see if there's any difference at the 1-2 week or 1 month mark!
after a mont of daily usage, the dark circles under my eyes remained the same

Maybe this is just for spot treatment and not day and night as is directed? This completely dried out the skin around my eyes, even though I put Cereve on top of it, while at the same time creating more puffs and lines I didn't have before. Tossed it in the trash. Beware Tik Tok recommendations!

I tend to wake up with puffy eyes and putting this on in the mornings has definitely helped me notice a difference as the day goes on. Takes a few uses to start noticing but it's become one of my favorite products

This cream feels light but is powerful and not heavy at all. It glides on easily and leaves the eye area (I have mature skin ;) ) super moisturised. I can see a visible difference in the under eye area, which was full on lines before- it can honestly say that the fine lines are diminishing and the dark eye bags are going away. This is my favourite product by far!

I find this too heavy for me but that could be just my age! I'm 76 after all and maybe there's nothing to help my bags now!! Sorry I'm sure it's great for you younger girls but just not for me. A shame as I love so many of the products from Inky.

Just within one week of use my eye area strated to feel sensitive and sting with any contact. Every product I used started stinging too, even water and the eye area became very irritated. I never experienced this with any skincare before. Very bad product formulation. Please reformulate. I had to put it to trash.
I truly believe this cream has already started to brighten my eye area and hydrates the under eye area

avis.titre: Very lightweight but no noticeable depuffing effect
avis.texte: It is very lightweight which is nice, people with dry skin would maybe prefer richer consistency. Unlike other caffeine creams this one doesn¬¥t have any effect on puffines. Strong caffeine serums depuffs your eyebags to the extent that you have to use second hydrating cream afterwards. This wants to be 2in1 but the effect is nonexistent. Nice quick morning light eye cream though. Does not irritate my sensitive eyes.
I am not sure if it's had any affect on my dark circles? To me there still dark. I will finish the tube. Then I will make a decision if 2 purchase again?
This is great to use daily, reduces puffiness, nice and smooth texture.

Like I said my boyfriend absolutely loves this! I think it's because it's like the only product with a name he knows what it is. I give 4 stars because find myself sensitive to eye creams and can't consistently use them. Overall I say it's a nice fun addition to your face routine

I can't say whether this works or not because I've had to stop using it after maybe two weeks. Problem? It makes my eye area itchy ,which is really uncomfortable. I used to have this problem often with eye creams, but this hasn't been much of a problem for the last 20 years, when companies may have become more attuned to skin sensitivities. So I was surprised and unhappy to have this happen to me again. The cream didn't much for me in the short time I used it so I won't miss it.

I work long hours and was noticing bags developing due to these early morning rises, however after a month of this eye cream they have been reduced massively. The puffiness and dark circles have almost disappeared and as a result my eyes look much better

This works great and I can't believe how inexpensive it is! Don't let the low price fool you! I'm 59 years old and this works. It didn't work overnight for me but I've seen a difference over the past two weeks using in the morning and night before bed. This doesn't leave a residue or oil slick. It soaks into my skin completely in about a minute which is when I then moisturize.

avis.titre: My second purchase I love it
avis.texte: This tube lasted me a month and a half, not only is the price reasonable but a little goes a long way with this product…no burning no fragrance, I'm not trying their hydrating serum because my skin did so well with the eye cream
This eye cream smooths out my eye area and doesn't cause irritation. I'm nearly 60 and this does a great job, for a very reasonable price. I prefer it to my previous product that was around $80.
Been using this product for a few weeks now and I definitely see a reduction in the purple tone under my eyes.
I really like this eye cream, very effective for under my eyes, and very affordable!!!
Not completely sure if this works yet because my eye bags are only really bad in morning and get better through day naturally but maybe helps speed up process.
This goes on daily. I use it, let it sit then apply Skinn Eye Balm to make sure it stays. I think it does a great job reducing the puff in my under eye area
Not sure if this is supposed to be a long term, or short term solution. Not much in the short term. I'll keep using it, and see if anything else pans out.

I apply this cream every night and I have genuinely noticed an improvement in my dark under eye circles. I am 23 and this is one of my first eye creams, so I'm sure this is not some miracle product. But I have seen improvement and I would recommend for the price point!!
I love the light texture of this cream and usually I use it in the morning- it really reduces puffiness under and around my eyes.
I use this at night, but must be careful not to get it into my eyes or it will burn a bit.
Have only just started using but positive so far. I love all of the inkey products have quite a few now definitely improved my skin texture

I never write reviews, but I had to for this product. I have hereditary eye bags under my eyes and was recommended this eye cream because it contains caffeine. I applied it, and about 10 minutes later, I looked in the mirror — I was in shock at how quickly it worked! My eye bags were reduced by around 50%! I'm not sure if it will provide long-term results, but as long as it works while I have it on, I'm more than happy. Nothing else has ever worked for my eye bags so i'm excited to see how this continues to work.
Really pleased with the results from this cream. Under eye less lines & looks brighter. Great value too. Will buy again.

I have very dry, sensitive eyes, so trying new things around them makes me nervous. This has brightened and moisturized around my eyes with no stingy or heaviness! Before I only used CeraVe Eye repair cream because everything else irritated; now Im moisturized with visible results!!!

Used Inkey Caffeine Eye Cream for a week and now my under-eyes are less ‚Äúcrypt keeper‚Äù and more ‚Äúmoderately well-rested raccoon.‚Äù It depuffed my eye bags so fast I'm starting to wonder if it's legally considered sorcery. Smells like nothing, feels like hope, and costs less than a sad coffee‚Äî10/10 would slap it on at 2am while pretending I sleep.

From the moment I first used the Caffeine Eye Cream from Inkey. I just knew it would be something I'd continue to use. May eyes are radiant and not looking at all tired. Thank you for taking care of our needs by introducing this wonderful product.
I've been using this for around three weeks now and I genuinely feel like I can see a difference. Definitely planning to keep it in my routine

I used this eye cream for 2 months and it didn't do anything bad? But it also didn't do much of anything at all? All I can really say is it hydrated. To be transparent, I do not struggle with chronic dark circles and most eye creams I've tried seem to give me the exact same results: meh. This one just isn't anything I need and I don't think I'll finish using it.
This is my second bottle, used to be more effective in the beginning
Light weight and very sensitive ... don't need to be too careful where you place around your eye as doesn't sting and I have sensitive skin
Heard great reviews but so far for me nothings improved disappointed
Great eye cream to use in the morning that brightens my under eye and reduces any puffiness.

This is without doubt my favourite eye cream. I have dark shadows between my eyes and nose as well as light shawing under my eyes. Caffeine eye cream makes a difference when I apply morning and night. A small convenient tube for travel and home use. I recommend it.
I've been repurchasing this over and over - I love the texture. It's great and sinks into the skin really nicely.

I like the texture of this cream and I definitely find it effective in reducing puffiness, but using this daily can sometimes cause irritation on my very sensitive eye area. I do like it more, however, than other caffeine eye products I've tried, and it is of course very affordable.
Best eye cream I've ever used softens lines and no more dryness.
i have it in the fridge and is great with puffiness and black circles
Love this eye cream really does brighten around the eyes, I look like a panda without it.

avis.titre: It's OK - needs to provide more moisture
avis.texte: I don't have bags or dark circles under my skin but there is no eye formulation by Inkey to address dryness. This is what my profile shows to use. It's OK - nothing significant. Doesn't burn my eyes (contacts, sensitive) so that's a plus. HOWEVER, there needs to be more MOISTURE added to the eye creams OR provide one for dryness.

Used it for just over a month now and can't see any difference. Maybe I just don't need it. Nice texture, lightweight, melts in easily and there's no irritation but I just can't see that it did anything.
I've been using this for months with almost little to no effect. Maybe it works for people with more prominent puffy eyes.
It works on wrinkles, however I'm still waiting for the dark circles to diminish!

I find this eye cream hydrating and comforting but it doesn't seem to have worked on my dark circles. It has reduced puffiness a little. I'm a bit sad because I had high hopes but it's just a normal eye cream like most others on the market. I was hoping to be blown away!

It's been a month but I can't really tell what this does. But it feels nice on. It also doesn't help that I'm using the retinol eye cream at night so I won't be able to tell its effect until I stop using it...

Reasonable price. Soaks into skin nicely. No perfume to it. Been using cream for a few weeks and haven't noticed any difference. On the website it said it helps reduce puffiness. Maybe I'll notice some change when I've finished the tube.

This eye cream works wonders, i have a newborn and stay awake at night. I wake up with puffy eyes and over time dark circles had developed around my eyes. When i started using this cream its almost like magic, cleared my puffiness and the dark circles disappeared. I highly recommend it

As I am 58 & find that I am more sensitive to products, especially eye cream as I have got older. However this absorbs really well & I use all over my eye (any spare on my finger I use on my lines around my mouth) even on my eye lid & brow
I had tried various eye products before. The puffiness left after two applications.
Absorbs very easily and has really helped with puffiness and dark circles
Not bad. I'm happy with the result. It doesn't work magic or reverse aging or get rid of dark ciclres under eyes, but it does make me feel good knowing I'm doing my part and taking care of myself ✔️
A light weighted eye cream. Good for everyday use but not helpful for my dark eye circles
I've got atopic eczema on face, it doesn't sting when I apply it. It's helped the slight swelling under eyes

You can tell the difference when i have put this on vs when i have not. it hydrates my under eyes and eyelids very well and lightens the darker redish rings around them after using it for a few days consistently

This wonderful little tube has been a saviour to my eyes. The cream does not cause any irritation to my skin and is definitely making a difference. My crepey eyelids and tired looking bags are starting to show improvement. Friends have mentioned that I look less tired! You only need to use a tiny amount so the tube will last for ages.
